subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR be rebased and adopted on top of the current iOS onboarding flow, or should its remaining Tailscale/auth pieces be split into narrower follow-ups?
rationale: The branch is useful and proven, but current main has merged an overlapping onboarding refresh and the PR is conflict-marked, so automation cannot safely choose the final product shape.

options.title: Rebase And Repair
options.body: Reconcile the branch with current onboarding, fix the branded typography finding, and keep the Tailscale/auth UX if it still matches maintainer direction.

options.title: Split Remaining Value
options.body: Close or pause this PR after extracting the Tailscale guidance and auth-copy improvements into narrower issues or PRs against current main.

options.title: Defer Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but wait for a broader decision across the one-step setup and discovered-gateway diagnostics work before asking for more changes.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Repair
recommendation.body: Reconcile the branch with current onboarding, fix the branded typography finding, and keep the Tailscale/auth UX if it still matches maintainer direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work on multi-gateway pairing and Tailnet route setup makes this the best available routing candidate for the product-direction choice.
